tei:div.tei:p: )na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī hūm̐/ hrīḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: byin rlabs rtsa ba o rgyan rin po che: 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul pa'i sku: drin chen bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul: zhi khro yi dam 'dus pa'i rang bzhin can: dngos grub rtsa ba thugs rje spyan ras gzigs: rta mgrin dbang chen 'khor 'das spyi dpal gtso: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa 'bul: ma mo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso mo ste: bar chad sel mdzad rdo rje phag mo yum: rigs kyi lha mo gsang ba ye shes dbyings: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul: hrīḥ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la: bdag gzhan rab gus gdung bas mchod pa 'bul: khyed kyi ye shes thugs rje byin rlabs kyis: mi rtog ting 'dzin ye shes skyed du gsol: nyams rtogs rig pa'i rtsal chen sbar du gsol: sku gsum zhing khams 'byongs par mdzad du gsol: bskyed rdzogs don gnyis 'bras bu khong chud nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa chen thob nas kyang : sems can thams cad sangs rgyas ma thob bar: 'gro ba'i don du lhun 'grub 'byung bar shog: ces bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las rtsa ba gsum gyi gsol 'debs rgyun khyer bsdus pa ja mchod du tshig bsgyur ba'o/// / )rgyal tshab dam pa rgya mtsho las 'khrungs shing*// skye 'chi med pa tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes// dregs pa tshar gcod srin pa'i kha gnon mdzad// mnyam med o rgyan rje la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod bla ma chos kyi rje// pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ rgya gar paṇa chen bod la bka' drin che// pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la 'das grongs med// da lta lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// o rgyan rin po che la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ ār+ya sa le'i yang srid spar stod 'khrungs// dga' tshal yi dam dgongs 'dus chos rten sogs// thugs gter bcu gnyis mnga' bdag stag sham pa// o rgyan bsam gtan gling par mchod pa 'bul/

༈ phyogs dus rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung*// 'khor lo'i mgon po stag sham chos rje gling*// byin rlabs thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i mgon// pad+ma bde byed rol pa la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ dag mnyam gzhi yi gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs// bskyed rdzogs lam gyi rnal 'byor mtha' ru phyin// zung 'jug 'bras bu mngon gyur tshe la dbang*// mchog tu grub pa'i zhabs la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung mtsho rgyal sa le 'od// rgyal sras lha rje rig 'dzin yab sras gnyis// don brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos sku mngon sum ston mdzad pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ rgya che rab zab chos dbyings rgya mtsho las// rin chen mchog brnyes bde gshegs pad+mo'i zhal// gsung mchog rdo rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtso// rgyal ba 'od dpag med la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya cher rol pa'i lha// zhi khro sku gsum lha la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ che mchog yang dag 'jam dpal rta mgrin dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /bla ma rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung mchog pad+ma'i gsung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas rngams chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ bskal pa'i me 'bar rlung nag 'khrugs pa'i klong*// bde gshegs kun 'dus hūm̐ nag rol pa rtsal// thugs mchog gsang bdag rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku// 'jigs byed khro rgyal dpal la mchod pa 'bul/

༈ chos sku spros bral dbyings yum kun bzang mo// longs spyod yongs rdzogs badz+ra wā ra hi// gang 'dul sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ stong nyid snying rje'i ngang las thugs rje'i sku// rgyal ba bskyed yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud 'dul seng gdong ma la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ chos sku skye med che mchog he ru ka /longs sku 'gag med ma ning khro bo'i rgyal// sprul sku rnal 'byor bstan srung sngags bdag gtso// lha chen dpal 'bar zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ chos sku bde chen dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// bstan pa srung phyir drag po'i tshul bstan pa// bstan la gdug pa ma lus tshar gcod pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ sngon tshe o rgyan chen po'i spyan snga ru// chos mdzad sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la// ma yis bu bzhin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras// nor gyi bdag po ār+ya dzam bha la// dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma// rnam sras 'khor dang bcas la mchod pa 'bul/ ༈ gnas 'di'i srung ma gnyan po 'khor bcas la// rgya ja ngad ldan mchod pa 'di phul bas// rnal 'byor dpon slob bsam pa 'grub pa dang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ ༈ 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas bla ma dkon mchog gsum// 'bral med gtan gyi gus pas mchod pa 'bul// gang byung thugs rjer shes pa'i mos gus kyis// rnam pa rgyun du dkon mchog mchod par shog ༈ bdag sogs 'khor bcas tshe rabs thams cad du// dkon mchog gsum po nam yang mi 'bral zhing*// dkon mchog gsum po rgyun du mchod pa yis// dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs 'jug par shog// /
